## Nonlinearity Notes for 10/29/2026

| Model | Polynomials | Orthogonal Polynomials | Bernstein Polynomials | Linear Splines | Cubic Splines | Restricted Cubic Splines (RCS) | Kernels |
|------|------|------|------|------|------|------|------|
| Basis | $$1, x, x^2, x^3$$; linear, parabolic, exponential | $$1, x^2 \perp x, x^3 \perp x, x$$; linear, parabolic, exponential | $$\binom{d}{k} ( x^k ) (1-x)^{d-k}$$; skewed right | $$(x-c)_+$$; rectified linear unit (ReLU) activation function | $$x, x^2, x^3, (x-c)^3_+$$ | $$w(x-c)^3_+$$ | $$k(x-c)$$; bell curve (normal distribution), skewed right |
| Tail | $$\infty , - \infty$$; unstable | $$\infty , - \infty$$; potential | A    | linear | exponential (fast) | linear | B    |
| Choices | G    | G    | A    | B    | C    | C    | C    |

from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures
